plan.notes: Source: 'BA Modern Languages: Writing - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Modern Languages), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. The plan prints 'FREN 1014 Elementary French I or SPAN 1014 Elementary Spanish I' (and the Semester 2 follow-on) as 3-credit courses even though the course numbers suggest 4 credits - kept verbatim with 3 credits. The plan's upper-level writing electives list is given after the plan: ENGL 3003 Advanced Professional Writing, ENGL 4503 Creative Writing Poetry, ENGL 3023 Technical Writing, ENGL 4513 Creative Writing Fiction, ENGL 3103 Advanced Composition, ENGL 4523 Writing: Special Topics, ENGL 3243 Theory and practice of Writing, ENGL 4533 Writing: Special Topics II, ENGL 4043 World Creation and Design, ENGL 4543 Creative Writing- Creative Nonfiction, ENGL 4103 Grant Writing, ENGL 4793 English Internship.

courses.choice_note: History choice: must complete one World History (HIST 1003/1013) and one US History/Government (HIST 2013/2023 or PSCI 2003) across the two history slots. Credits shown for HIST 1003 (first-listed).
